sloka: जाम्बवाम्स् त्व् अथ सम्प्रेक्ष्य शास्त्र बुद्ध्या विचक्षणः ।वाक्यम् विज्ञापयाम् आस गुणवद् दोष वर्जितम् ॥६-१७-४५॥।।
transliteration: jāmbavāms tv atha samprekṣya śāstra buddhyā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।vākyam vijñāpayām āsa guṇavad doṣa varjitam ॥6-17-45॥।।

translations.english: Then, enlightened Jambavan who was endowed with sense of discrimination, considering all facts made his submission which was free from flaws.
